title: jasminum subhumile var. glabricymosum
intro: Jasminum subhumile var. glabricymosum, commonly known as dwarf jasmine or climbing jasmine, is a low-maintenance, evergreen climber native to Southeast Asia and China. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and lower blood pressure, due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum subhumile var. glabricymosum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their therapeutic effects.
